title: Multiplayer Sprint C — drop-in/out behaviour, 5s reconnect grace, spectate-until-next-round for mid-round joiners
intent: After Sprint B (GDP-2026-05-22-011) lands, the gameplay is shared between tabs but the JOIN / LEAVE behaviour is still abrupt: connecting mid-round drops the new player straight into the arena (where they're likely insta-killed by an in-flight blast), and disconnecting kills the bomber immediately even on a momentary network blip. Sprint C polishes the world-lifecycle: a player joining mid-round SPECTATES the current round (sees everything, controls nothing) until the next round-restart auto-spawns them; a disconnected player's bomber is HELD for 5 seconds before despawn, allowing tab refresh / network hiccup recovery; leaving deliberately (close tab) STILL despawns immediately. The drop-in/out model from `gdd.md` Multiplayer + `notes/DynaBomber.md §6.1` finally fully expresses.
rationale: Source: GDP-2026-05-22-009 acceptance hints (Sprint C bullet) + `docs/game-design/gameplay-systems.md §9.3` (drop-in/out rules with the spectate-until-next-round + 5s grace defaults already documented). After Sprint B's headline acceptance, this polish is what separates 'multiplayer prototype' from 'world that feels alive'. Without it, every refresh / unstable wifi user gets punished. Sized SHOULD because the headline gameplay works without it; Sprint C is essential polish, not a blocker.
acceptanceHints: Depends on GDP-2026-05-22-011 (Sprint B). Recipe + position sync are already shipped (S109+S112).
SPECTATE-UNTIL-NEXT-ROUND (mid-round join):
Server tracks RoundState.phase. When a client.join arrives while phase ∈ {'playing'}:
Server marks the new Presence entity with `pendingSpawn: true` and DOES NOT spawn a bomber for them in the current round.
Client receives the snapshot; sees existing bombers + bombs + blasts; player input has no effect (no bomber attached).
Client UI: a centre-bottom banner reads 'SPECTATING — joining next round'. Optional: a chevron above the spectator's would-be-spawn cell.
When RoundState.phase flips to {'won', 'lost', 'draw'} → auto-restart fires → at the new round's spawn step, the pending-spawn presence becomes a real bomber spawned at the next available spawn cell.
Multiple spectators waiting: spawn in entity-id order across the round-start.

Edge case — no spawn cells available (4-player arena full): spectator KEEPS waiting through the round; server bumps player count target or simply holds them. Document in the spec which: recommend HOLD (no auto-promotion to mega-arena).
5S RECONNECT GRACE (disconnect path):
Server detects WebSocket close. Two cases:
Deliberate close (client.leave message received before TCP close): despawn bomber IMMEDIATELY. Their live bombs continue to fuse + detonate (server-owned, no orphan cleanup).

Network drop (TCP close without client.leave): mark Presence as `disconnected: true, disconnectedAt: now`. Hold the bomber in place for 5 seconds. Bomber is alive but frozen (input ignored, fuse on owned bombs continues, alive=false flip still possible via blast).
If a client.join with the SAME playerId reconnects within 5s: clear disconnected flag, resume normal input → snap to wherever server says they are.
If 5s elapses without reconnect: despawn the bomber (same as deliberate leave from there).

Player ID continuity: client persists its assigned playerId in sessionStorage (NOT localStorage — same tab only) so a refresh-within-grace reconnects to the same bomber. New tab = new playerId, no auto-reclaim.
PROTOCOL EXTENSIONS:
client.join: gains optional `resumePlayerId: string` field. Server validates: if playerId is in the disconnected-grace pool, resume; otherwise allocate new.
client.leave: explicit deliberate-leave signal (sent before WebSocket close on graceful unmount). Existing protocol may already have this — verify.
Snapshot: Presence entities gain `disconnected: boolean` + `pendingSpawn: boolean` fields. Clients use these to render the spectator UI + the disconnected-grayed-out marker on the minimap.
VISUAL TREATMENT:
Spectator on the local client: HUD shows banner; minimap marker for self appears at the would-be-spawn cell in low-opacity.

Disconnected bomber on REMOTE clients: bomber renders in greyscale (apply a desaturation tween to its mesh tree) for the 5s grace. Pops back to full colour on reconnect. Visual cue that 'this player is having connection trouble'.
Local-disconnect view: the local client may show a 'reconnecting...' overlay if the WebSocket reports disconnect — graceful UX. Not strictly required for the server-side rules; recommend.
ROUND-RESOLVE INTERACTION:

If a player disconnects mid-round → 5s grace freezes their bomber → round ends mid-grace (e.g. opponent kills them, or timeout). Round-resolve fires NORMALLY. The frozen disconnected bomber counts as alive for tally purposes UNLESS killed by a blast during the grace (alive-flip still works on grace-frozen bombers).
Per gameplay-systems.md §6.4 'no full-world reset on player leave': leaving mid-round does NOT abort the round.
DETERMINISM:
Spectator queue order is by entity-id, deterministic.
5s grace timer is wall-clock on the server (not tick-based — the server's tick rate may differ from clients').
Reconnect resumption is idempotent: same playerId always resumes to the same bomber.
ACCEPTANCE PLAYTEST:
Tab A starts round; 5 seconds into the round, Tab B joins → Tab B sees 'SPECTATING' banner; Tab A's player runs around normally → at round-resolve + auto-restart, Tab B spawns as a real bomber.
Tab A refreshes mid-round → Tab B sees Tab A's bomber go grey for ≤ 5s, then resume colour as Tab A's refreshed session reconnects → no double-spawn.
Tab A closes intentionally (clicks browser close button — sends client.leave) → Tab B sees Tab A's bomber despawn immediately; Tab A's live bombs continue to fuse + detonate.
Tab A loses wifi for 8 seconds → Tab B sees grey for 5s then despawn → Tab A reconnects after grace expires → Tab A enters as a fresh spectator awaiting next round.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Persistent sessions across full server restart (server reboot loses the in-grace pool — acceptable).
Cross-device session migration (mobile ↔ desktop with same playerId).
Friend invites / private rooms / room codes.
Reconnect grace beyond 5s configurability per server (5s is hardcoded for the first cut).
Spawn-cell starvation auto-promotion (4 max bombers; spectators just queue).
